[Section] Full results of Performance Analysis over Human-Labeled Question Types
[source_id=57] Table TABREF45 gives our full evaluation on human annotated question types.
[source_id=58] Compared with the BiDAF model, one interesting observation is that the generative baseline gets much worse results on ambiguous questions. We conjecture that although these questions are meaningless, they still have many words that overlapped with the contexts. This can give BiDAF potential advantage over the generative baseline.
